# FPS Limitation Patcher **Removes the FPS and performance limits set by PowerKeeper and Joyose on MIUI and HyperOS.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - No FPS caps from PowerKeeper: no 60 Hz app lists, no video/idle drops (YouTube and other video apps), no Game Turbo limits - No per-game frame caps from Joyose (Xiaomi's game tuning app) - No refresh-rate drop when the phone heats up - Battery saver no longer caps CPU speed (its other savings stay on) - Hidden PowerKeeper cloud info menu unlocked on stable ROMs: dial `*#*#76937#*#*` - Closes a security hole that let any app point PowerKeeper's power policy to its own server - Patches the PowerKeeper and Joyose apps already on your device during install, so it matches your ROM - Small (about 4 MB): uses the phone's own Android runtime, no Java bundled - Thermal safety limits are untouched, overheat protection still works ## Requirements - MIUI or HyperOS, Android 11 or newer (up to Android 16) - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch - Android 13+: signature verification must be disabled (e.g. with [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) or [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch)) ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in the Magisk, KernelSU or APatch app (not in recovery). 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Flash it again after every ROM update. - Updating from an older version is fine, the original apps are patched again. - Some games pick their own FPS limit per phone model (for example PUBG, Genshin); a system mod cannot change that. - When the phone gets very hot, the system can still lower game performance to protect it. ---
Made by **[🅺🅰🆂🅷🅸](https://t.me/kakashi1v1)** · part of **[Mods Center](https://github.com/Mods-Center)** [Website](https://modscenter.org) · [Channel](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs) · [Support group](https://t.me/bootloop_discussion) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/issues)

FPS Limitation Patcher

Removes the FPS and performance limits set by PowerKeeper and Joyose on MIUI and HyperOS.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • No FPS caps from PowerKeeper: no 60 Hz app lists, no video/idle drops (YouTube and other video apps), no Game Turbo limits
  • No per-game frame caps from Joyose (Xiaomi's game tuning app)
  • No refresh-rate drop when the phone heats up
  • Battery saver no longer caps CPU speed (its other savings stay on)
  • Hidden PowerKeeper cloud info menu unlocked on stable ROMs: dial `*#*#76937#*#*`
  • Closes a security hole that let any app point PowerKeeper's power policy to its own server
  • Patches the PowerKeeper and Joyose apps already on your device during install, so it matches your ROM
  • Small (about 4 MB): uses the phone's own Android runtime, no Java bundled
  • Thermal safety limits are untouched, overheat protection still works

    • Requirements

  • MIUI or HyperOS, Android 11 or newer (up to Android 16)
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch
  • Android 13+: signature verification must be disabled (e.g. with [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) or [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch))

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in the Magisk, KernelSU or APatch app (not in recovery).
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Flash it again after every ROM update.
  • Updating from an older version is fine, the original apps are patched again.
  • Some games pick their own FPS limit per phone model (for example PUBG, Genshin); a system mod cannot change that.
  • When the phone gets very hot, the system can still lower game performance to protect it.

    • ---
